section.title: Selected Work
section.description: A source-backed set of projects spanning full-stack product delivery, embedded security, and machine learning systems.

openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.description: Portfolio source and public code presence built around modular React and TypeScript components.

projects.title: Sororine
projects.description: Full-stack safety intelligence platform built with Next.js, Prisma, SQLite, and stateless JWT sessions.

details.mission: Full-stack safety intelligence platform built with Next.js App Router and TypeScript, featuring API routes, an ORM-backed data layer, and stateless JWT-secured sessions.
implementationDetails: Built the application with Next.js App Router and TypeScript.
Added Prisma-backed persistence with SQLite for a lightweight data layer.
Implemented stateless JWT sessions and geospatial risk scoring for incident aggregation.
details.keyTakeaways: Delivered a secure product-focused platform with a compact data stack and clear session boundaries.

projects.title: SleeQC
projects.description: Adaptive embedded security prototype for ESP32-S3 using TensorFlow Lite and resource-aware profile switching.

details.mission: Resource-adaptive post-quantum cryptography system built for an ESP32-S3 edge device.
implementationDetails: Prototyped a resource-adaptive post-quantum cryptography system on an ESP32-S3.
Deployed a TensorFlow Lite decision engine to monitor runtime metrics.
Switched between security profiles automatically based on device conditions.
details.keyTakeaways: The prototype demonstrated the feasibility of deploying adaptive security solutions on resource-constrained edge devices.

projects.title: Circle Communications Dashboard
projects.description: React and MUI dashboard work from a software developer internship, including state management and streamed invoice generation.

details.mission: React frontend work for internal communications tooling with MUI, Redux Toolkit, and contextual real-time synchronization.
implementationDetails: Built the UI with React and MUI components.
Used Redux Toolkit and React Context API for state synchronization.
Generated structured PDF invoices and fixed an unbounded query with server-side pagination.
details.keyTakeaways: The delivery showed that the frontend could stay responsive while the backend work removed a major latency spike.

projects.title: CIGRE-MV Fault Detection Engine
projects.description: Python-based random forest ensemble for fault detection and localization on synthetic power grid scenarios.

details.mission: Modular fault detection engine for CIGRE-MV power networks using Python and ensemble learning.
implementationDetails: Built a multi-tier random forest ensemble using object-oriented Python.
Synthesized more than 21,000 labeled power grid scenarios with pandapower.
Reduced voltage computation time by 70% by replacing the Newton-Raphson solver with a DLPF-based implementation.
details.keyTakeaways: The dataset scale and solver optimization made the prototype viable for real-time inference research.
